dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with a high-contrast gradient between the light-grey outer ring and the dark interior/exterior surface. Prominent structures exhibit non-uniform thickness in the ring borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters appearing as small, solid nodes primarily located at the vertices of ring intersections or along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A series of interconnected centroids forming an irregular polygonal chain along the dorsal midline, with a notable obtuse triangle formed by three prominent annuli in the upper-mid lateral region.
